verdict.rationale: Hummingbird's homepage says it "moves cases between agents and your team" and "keeps every decision defensible." It also offers to screen customers and disposition alerts "more intelligently," and the docs describe an automatic audit trail. Together this suggests an in-product agent that works screening and alert dispositions with a recorded trail, but only as marketing-level claims. missing for 10: documentation of an in-product AI agent that specifically reviews screening matches, evidence that the agent records a per-match rationale, details on how agent decisions are logged or approved, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a ai-native, I can use an in-product agent to review screening matches with recorded rationale

citations.quote: It automates routine work, moves cases between agents and your team, and keeps every decision defensible.
Screen customers and disposition alerts more intelligently.
Automatic audit trail: This feature ensures that you have comprehensive audits of all work that occurs in Hummingbird.
